description: Run to see a wallet's recent activity, or to get a real transaction ID to look into. Never make up a transaction ID; get one here. Lists a wallet's latest transactions, newest first, with whether each worked and a plain error name for failures. Inputs: wallet: The wallet address to read the transactions of. how_many (optional): How many transactions to return. Default 10. network (optional): Which Solana network to read. Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/history.
name: history
